thread:
tess: Heads-up — new starterkit repro: jsonMode + fn-call + auth refresh cause schema helper to reject valid payloads.
aj: what's the exact failure?
tess: The function call arguments get back as a string for some requests after a token refresh, which then trips our strict validator. From the network dump:
```n{\"type\":\"function_call\",\"name\":\"charge_card\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"amount\\\":\\\"100\\\",\\\"currency\\\":\\\"USD\\\"}\"}n```
Note: amount should be a number, not a quoted string.
maria: Interesting — different from the usual double-stringify case: here the inner JSON ended up with numbers coerced to strings. Could be stringify + JSON.stringify on an already-stringified body with some middleware that casts numbers to strings for headers.
rosa: Which SDK/version? Is this starterkit-specific or in core?
tess: Starterkit using @redwood/sdk-js v0.7.3. Repro steps: force a 401 on the first try, allow auto-refresh, then capture the parsed payload in the helper.
aj: I can reproduce locally. The retry wrapper calls a lightweight scrubber that clones and normalizes the body for metrics; that scrubber coerces primitives to strings if it runs on the serialized text instead of the raw object. When transport serializes again it preserves those string values.
maria: So parity note: python path didn't hit this because its scrubber runs on bytes and preserves numbers. Another parity mismatch to log.
rosa: UX pain: validator throws a terse "schema mismatch" and the starter app shows a generic error during onboarding. Users drop off.
aj: Fix plan: 1) make scrubber idempotent (operate on object clones, not serialized text), 2) make validator expose a friendly hint when types differ due to retry/scrubbers, e.g. "expected number but got string — possible retry double-serialize or scrubber coercion; see devex/docs#fncall-retry".
tess: Can we also add a non-strict parsing mode for starterkits that attempts to coerce number-like strings back to numbers? That would help new users while we patch the transport.
maria: Yes, but flag it opt-in (validator.lenient = true) so production doesn't silently coerce bad types. Add tests for both strict and lenient modes.
rosa: I'll update the starterkit README with a short troubleshooting snippet and a note about pinning token refresh during quickstarts.
dev-bot: Created issue RD-DEVEX-602: scrubber-coerce-on-retry -> assigned to aj; CI: starterkit-integration/auth-refresh-type-check failed reproducing the bug.
aj: I'll push a small PR that 1) guards the scrubber, 2) adds validator lenient flag, and 3) a tiny integration that forces 401 and asserts final parsed arguments types.
tess: thanks — this will help cut down onboarding support tickets.
maria: also add a short line in the SDK changelog about the transport/body contract (transport expects string|Buffer; middleware must not stringify).
rosa: marked action items; leaving the thread open until PR merges and starters updated.
